description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch Launch Trailer for SoulQuest, the hit action hack-and-slash game developed by SoulBlade Studio and Tomas J Pereyra. author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Stranded Deep 2 announcement teaser trailer for this upcoming survival sandbox sequel game. Standed Deep 2 will be available on PC.

In Stranded Deep 2, the survival sandbox expands into an unforgiving desert wilderness. Rather than being stranded in the vast expanse of the Pacific Ocean, players must now survive within a harsh landscape shaped by scorching heat, winding rivers, towering canyons and deadly wildlife, with a whole new world of biomes to explore and resources to discover. But the desert is only the beginning.

Stranded Deep 2 is a frontier exploration survival game. Players start as survivors, grow into explorers, and gradually discover that there is far more to the world than simply staying alive. At the heart of the experience is an endless river world, carving through canyons, dunes and valleys and providing a lifeline into a vast wilderness filled with danger and discovery.
title: Stranded Deep 2 - Official Announcement Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Join Yuriri Naka, voice of the Oni Lady, as she introduces Ifuu and Burai in this latest Onimusha: Way of the Sword trailer for the upcoming action game. Check out the trailer to see Ifuu and Burai in action and learn more about these brothers. Onimusha: Way of the Sword will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, Xbox on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store) on September 4, 2026. A demo is out now.

Ifuu is the younger of the Genma siblings who have made Kennin-ji Temple their lair. He seeks out duels with worthy challengers, alongside his older brother, Burai. Capable of stirring up powerful gales, he wields the wind to blast away his foes.

Burai is the elder of the Genma siblings who have made Kennin-ji Temple their lair. Just like his younger brother, the promise of good fight gets his blood pumping. He fights with the combination of a naginata-like polearm and contraptions that unleash bursts of lightning.

#OnimushaWayOfTheSword #Gaming #IGN
title: Onimusha: Way of the Sword - Official Ifuu & Burai Trailer
